shadows.name: step-explanation
shadows.purpose: Transient Mantine explanation popover; primary surfaces remain flat.

shadows.name: bubble-floor
shadows.purpose: Bubble lesson and static landing preview. Transparent shadow-only floor uses bubble-ink; clay columns do not receive shadows and stop casting at erosion >= 0.3. Default 3D casts soft contact shadows; retained 2D has no object shadows. Big O uses the same floor opacity and ink with its own shadow map.

motion.name: bubble-daydream
motion.purpose: Bubble-sort playback. Analytical damped spring moves swaps through opposing ±0.85 depth arcs, 0.035 lift and ±0.045-radian tilt. Native CanvasTexture value sprites are depth-tested, retain a minimum screen scale and fade with erosion; accessible DOM values and stationary projected indices remain. Both views share the Canvas and trace clock; switching does not reset or pause playback. Pause freezes the shared clock, seek/edit restores exact geometry, Slow loop opts out. Reduced motion uses the static array renderer.

motion.name: bubble-view-transition
motion.purpose: Bubble lesson native 2D/3D radios ease the orthographic camera between front-facing and a shallow fixed angle; no continuous orbit. Default 3D; retained 2D flattens column depth to z scale 0.01. The landing preview is static 3D with demand rendering.

motion.name: bubble-background
motion.value: slow domain-warped drift; faint swap ripple; relaxed erosion/reformation flow
motion.purpose: Bubble lesson and static landing preview. A full-canvas shader behind both views blends bubble-canvas, bubble-stone and bubble-ink with a quiet centre and fading edges. The ripple follows the camera-projected active pair. Cumulative playback time and speed drive the wash; pause and hidden tabs freeze it, while seek/edit/reset restore a deterministic state. Reduced motion, scene failure or WebGL context loss uses the existing static array renderer.

motion.name: clay-damped-spring
motion.purpose: Shared analytical spring: bubble swaps over 1400ms on the playback clock; Big O size changes over 1000ms with demand rendering. Big O first render and reduced motion use static final piles.

focusRings.name: focus-outline
focusRings.purpose: Visible keyboard focus on buttons and links.

narrative.overview: The approved concept uses green accents, light paper, muted sage surfaces and lighter headings across the landing and lessons. Playful Korean/English introductions invite watching; exact algorithm summaries and step evidence support closer reading. The execution canvas leads, with source code available below when curiosity calls.
keyCharacteristics: Light paper, sage actions and restrained borders.
Lighter headings and quiet bilingual copy.
Visible execution with code closed until requested.
Monospaced values and distinct execution states.

rules.name: The Shared Scale Rule
rules.body: Big O comparison scenes use identical block geometry and the same camera units: more work means more blocks, never a normalized height or a larger individual block.

rules.name: The Model Evidence Rule
rules.body: Pair geometric work counts with their exact formulas and the model caption; never describe them as measured runtime.

dos: Do use the Korean and English product names and preserve the incumbent favicon.
Do keep Korean and English copy readable at narrow widths.
Do place playful taglines alongside exact summaries and step explanations.
Do lead with execution and keep code available through a closed native disclosure.
Do pair execution colors with textual or numeric evidence.
donts: Don't present the Big O growth model as measured runtime.
Don't collapse comparison, swap, settled and matched lesson states into one accent.
Don't turn precise input constraints or error messages into jokes.
